title: LegacyDoll
description: A simple forge mod implementing paper doll on Minecraft 1.8.9.
body:
# Legacy Doll
A simple forge mod implementing paper doll on Minecraft 1.8.9.

## Features
- Support putting doll on the right
- Custom position and transform

## Getting started
Download the mod from here.  
Requirements:
- Minecraft 1.8.9.
- Forge Mod Loader.
- The mod jar in your `mods` folder.

## To be noticed
The mod uses OneConfig as its config library, which requires a period of time setting up things on first run.
